newsitem.title: UK: UK COMMERCIAL RADIO TO STUDY BEST WAYS TO GROW.
newsitem.headline: UK COMMERCIAL RADIO TO STUDY BEST WAYS TO GROW.

text.p: Britain's Commercial Radio Companies Association (CRCA) said on Thursday it appointed National Economic Research Associates to study the best ways to develop UK commercial radio.
The study aims to identify the best overall circumstances for the UK commercial radio sector's audience and revenue growth, CRCA, the trade association for UK commercial radio, said.

The report, expected to be published in early 1998, will examine: the growth in competition for listeners' leisure time, the growth in competition from others seeking advertising funding, the position of the BBC, the onset of digitisation, media convergence, spectrum allocation, the role of regulation, likely legislative change, desirable legislative change, and relevant experience in other countries.
National Economic Research Associates is an international consulting firm.
